edits.text: PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff’s First Requests for Production as set forth below. These responses are made subject to the specific objections stated herein and are based on information presently available to Defendant.

1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to each request to the extent it seeks information protected from disclosure by the attorney-client privilege, the work-product doctrine, or any other applicable privilege or protection. Any general objection is stated for preservation purposes and is not intended to expand or replace an objection specific to an individual request.

2. PRODUCTION. Subject to any specific objections stated in response to an individual request, Defendant will produce responsive, non-privileged documents within its possession, custody, or control. The scope of any production and any applicable limitations should be stated in the response to the corresponding request.

3. PRIVILEGE LOG. To the extent documents responsive to a request are withheld on the basis of privilege or protection, Defendant will identify them in a privilege log, subject to any applicable agreement or court order.
4. RESERVATION. Defendant reserves the right to supplement or amend these responses as permitted by the applicable rules and any agreement or order of the Court.
